title: Protecting the data
summary: Rules in methods, a getter, and transfer built from them.

steps.title: The object guards itself
steps.say: Nobody outside can set `balance_` directly. They have to ask, and the methods enforce the rules.

marks.label: can't take more than there is

steps.title: A getter
steps.say: Read-only access: other code can see the balance but not change it.

steps.title: Reuse the rules
steps.say: `transfer` uses `withdraw` and the other account's `deposit`, so the rules live in one place.

steps.title: Run it
steps.say: Click the **Run** button (▷) at the top right of the file. The output appears in the terminal at the bottom.

waitFor.hint: run the program and read the output.
